Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the broadcaster, conflating Phoenix New Media (an online media company) with Phoenix Television/Phoenix Satellite Television Holdings Ltd (the Cayman Islands-registered TV broadcaster). Despite WebSurfer’s sources showing Phoenix Television operates Phoenix Hong Kong Channel and is Cayman-registered, the Planner incorrectly concluded Phoenix New Media launched the channel, leading to the wrong final answer.
